verifications.claim: WrestleMania 42 streams exclusively on the ESPN App with an ESPN Unlimited Plan in the United States.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Watch live: ESPN Unlimited | First hour will simulcast live on ESPN'; R3: 'Night 1 ... begins at 6 p.m. ET on ESPN2 and continues on ESPN Unlimited after the first hour'; R4: 'The first hour (6:00-7:00 p.m. ET) of WrestleMania will be available to watch on ESPN2 on Saturday and ESPN on Sunday. The rest of the show will be exclusive to ESPN Unlimited'; R5: 'first hour of each night were simulcast on ESPN2 and ESPN'
verifications.reasoning: References confirm streaming on ESPN App/Unlimited, but first hour simulcasts on linear TV (ESPN2/ESPN), contradicting 'exclusively' on app.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Night 2 on Sunday Date: April 19, 2026'; R4: 'Saturday, April 18'; R5: 'April 18–19, 2026'; R6: 'Night 1 (Saturday, April 18) ... Night 2 (Sunday, April 19)'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the exact dates April 18-19, 2026.
